notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed issue with final guardian boss moving too fast
- Fixed issue with start vehicles when starting a training mission from another mission
- Fixed issue with challenge restrictions when starting a training mission from a challenge mission
- Some small improvements to challenge missions objectives-validations

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
- Removed experimental slowmotion mode
- Fixed issues with data not being cleaned up upon switching modes

notes.title: Shooter-mode
notes.content:
The new update features the addition of the new [b]Shooter[/b]-mode, which let's you play [b]the entire game[/b] in a more traditional shootemup way!

It retains Hijack Overdrive's iconic and unique hijacking mechanic, but replaces the fleet-managing aspect with a more direct shooter approach.

The original mode is renamed to [b]Fleet[/b]-mode and will ofcourse remain the default game-mode.



[i]Update Notes for version 1.1.0:
- New game-mode: Shooter-mode
- Fixed crash related to selecting vehicles when empty garage[/i]

notes.title: SHMUP Fest Sale: 35% Off
notes.content:
In celebration of the [b]new Shooter-mode[/b], Hijack Overdrive will be [b]35%[/b] off during the SHMUP Fest.
The sale starts September 25, and lasts until October 2 (10am Pacific Time).

It's the perfect time to start playing Hijack Overdrive in either Shooter or Fleet-mode!

[i]The new Shooter-mode becomes available at the start of the fest, in both the demo and the full game.[/i]

notes.title: Shooter-mode Announcement
notes.content:
The new update features the addition of the new [b]Shooter[/b]-mode, which let's you play[b] the entire game[/b] in a more traditional [b]shootemup [/b]way!

It retains Hijack Overdrive's iconic and unique hijacking mechanic, but replaces the fleet-managing aspect with a more direct shooter approach.

The original mode is renamed to [b]Fleet[/b]-mode and will ofcourse remain the default game-mode.

The update will become available on Monday September 25th.
